segments.text: H3.C runs Miniax's H3 video model on Apple silicon in plain C and metal. No Python and no PyTorch anywhere from the
Reddus author. It generates video with synced stereo audio from a prompt from first and last frame anchors or from ordered image video and audio
references. You'll still need the Miniax H3 checkpoint, FFmpeg, and substantial unified memory with optimization focused
